game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail, a trail through hollow logs: the wood elf archer must handle cursed treants while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Sum Sprint: Accumulate a total across a loop to pay a toll at Hollow Log Trail.
theme: Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail: a trail through hollow logs
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Source organization: build a valid C source file that prints 20. Put preprocessing before main; keep declarations and statements inside its body. Then test its compiler-factory route: Build the splitter at (2, 3), with the upper processing path on row 0 and lower path on row 5. Alternate items between A (upper) and B (lower); wait if the scheduled branch is blocked. Merge the two plate streams at (8, 3), then use the shared assembler and output. Deliver exactly 13 components (7 upper, 6 lower). Set the gold-socket controller batch to 13.
controls: Drag sprites onto the grid. R rotates new pieces. Set fork output directions and router conditions in the inspector. Splitters alternate; routers evaluate each item; mergers accept one waiting item at a time fairly. Set batch size, connect power, repair rounded conveyors, then Run or Step. Grid controls are the keyboard alternative.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Sum Sprint' (Week 5 slot 5), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Hollow Log Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: C Components, Keywords, Preprocessor and Organization

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about total to power up the wood elf archer and open the mushroom ring.
source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
source_game_title: Sum Sprint – Hollow Log Trail Streak
hint: Alternate items between A (upper) and B (lower); wait if the scheduled branch is blocked. Merge the two plate streams at (8, 3), then use the shared assembler and output. Branch contracts: A: 7 components via upper_4, shared_assembler to output_shared; B: 6 components via lower_4, shared_assembler to output_shared. Power the junctions and production machines.
